items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Crawford was the leader. Crawford played first drums in the band, and Mose played second fiddle.

ctx.x: So I guess that helped. Because if we'd got some other guy that was strong in another style, it would have confused the thing. So he just wrote on top of Crawford. Crawford was the leader. Crawford played first drums in the band, and Mose played second fiddle.
Was Trummy there while you were there?
